chapter: Reel 2: Perez, brass bands and early life
title: The women's band that inspired him
summary: He describes an all-women outfit on a touring circuit whose trumpet players made him want to play trumpet.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone

blocks.x: I see. And you're a senior, though. That's right. He's named after. I wanted to ask you about that ladies band, All Women, huh, in the band?

Oh, yeah. I don't know what outfit it was, but it was a female outfit. We used to play on all from stage. I don't remember which one it was at that time. But it was very fine. And I see those women who used to play the trumpet with so much ease, all the three or four of them would come to the front of the stage and know all men that could play trumpets. So I decided that's what I wanted to play. Were they from where or were they from here?
Well, they were from away. I see. That's why I'm-
I was trying with a circuit, you know, an off-hand circuit at that time.
